Calculates the slope of each cell along its drainage direction, as the drop to the downstream cell over their distance. Unlike the gradient, it is the slope the water follows.

**Toolbox folder:** Geomorphology<br>
**Status:** Tested<br>
**Keywords:** Geomorphology, Slope, Drainage directions<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.Slope`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inPit` | raster file | m |  | The map of the depitted elevation. |
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `doHandleNegativeSlope` | boolean |  | `false` | Set the negative slopes, which can occur with drainage directions not computed on this elevation map, to the smallest positive value. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outSlope` | output file | m/m | The map of the slope, as the tangent of the slope angle. |
